rule-643.name: const unsafe fn from_utf8_unchecked
rule-643.rule: The bytes passed in must be valid UTF-8.
rule-643.dsl:
all([
    b < 128
    or (
        194 <= b <= 223
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1 < len($1)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 191
    )
    or (
        224 <= b <= 239
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2 < len($1)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 191
        and (b != 224 or $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] >= 160)
        and (b != 237 or $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 159)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2] <= 191
    )
    or (
        240 <= b <= 244
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 3 < len($1)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 191
        and (b != 240 or $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] >= 144)
        and (b != 244 or $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 143)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2] <= 191
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 3] <= 191
    )
    or (
        128 <= b <= 191
        and (
            (
                b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start >= 1
                and 194 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start - 1] <= 244
            )
            or (
                b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start >= 2
                and 224 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start - 2] <= 244
            )
            or (
                b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start >= 3
                and 240 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start - 3] <= 244
            )
        )
    )
    for b in $1
])

all([
    b < 128
    or (
        194 <= b <= 223
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1 < len($1)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 191
    )
    or (
        224 <= b <= 239
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2 < len($1)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 191
        and (b != 224 or $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] >= 160)
        and (b != 237 or $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 159)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2] <= 191
    )
    or (
        240 <= b <= 244
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 3 < len($1)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 191
        and (b != 240 or $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] >= 144)
        and (b != 244 or $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 143)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2] <= 191
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 3] <= 191
    )
    or (
        128 <= b <= 191
        and (
            (
                b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start >= 1
                and 194 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start - 1] <= 244
            )
            or (
                b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start >= 2
                and 224 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start - 2] <= 244
            )
            or (
                b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start >= 3
                and 240 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start - 3] <= 244
            )
        )
    )
    for b in $1
])

rule-322-initialized.name: const unsafe fn read < T >
rule-322-initialized.rule: Observation regression: every byte of the pointee region is initialized, including padding. This is separate from typed validity.
rule-322-initialized.api: const unsafe fn read < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule-322-initialized.note: Synthetic byte-initialization observation regression, including padding; distinct from ptr::read's typed-validity contract.

rule-322.name: const unsafe fn read < T >
rule-322.rule: `src` must point to a properly initialized value of type `T`.
rule-322.api: const unsafe fn read < T > (src : * const T) -> T

rule-643-result-valid.name: const unsafe fn from_utf8_unchecked
rule-643-result-valid.rule: The returned str must contain language-valid initialized UTF-8 bytes.
rule-643-result-valid.note: Result-view regression for from_utf8_unchecked, whose body preserves the byte sequence without a UTF-8 UB precondition check.

rule-643-sequence-valid.name: const unsafe fn from_utf8_unchecked
rule-643-sequence-valid.rule: Observation regression: the byte sequence contains language-valid initialized u8 values. This is separate from UTF-8 encoding validity.
rule-643-sequence-valid.note: The original UTF-8 contract remains rule-643; this synthetic rule tests sequence memory validity only.
